prerequisites: Foundations of the first semesters of AI-B are required, as the courses build upon the regular curriculum.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can freely choose a subject from a given catalog of subjects in the FWP modules.
Content is subject-related to the study, e.g., from the topics of computer science, AI, cyber security, or other relevant courses.
The catalog of subjects is always announced with the study plan, allowing for individual specialization and deepening.
Subject-specific and methodological competencies, as well as social and personal competencies, are emphasized differently depending on the chosen course.

syllabus_topics: Contents are determined by the chosen subject.
assessment_rules: The exact examination form (according to the study and examination regulations: written examination 90 min or oral examination 15 min or PStA) will be announced with the publication of the subject catalog in the study plan. The grade weighting for the module is 5/210.
